segments.he: אַחַר כָּךְ בַּלַּיְלָה בָּא אֶצְלֵנוּ אִישׁ אֶחָד שֶׁהוּא חַזָּן בְּאֵיזֶה בֵּית הַכְּנֶסֶת שָׁם, שְׁמוֹ רַבִּי יַעֲקב וְהוּא יָכל קְצָת לְדַבֵּר בִּלְשׁוֹנֵנוּ וְגַם בַּיּוֹם דִבֵּר עִמָּנוּ קְצָת מִדֵּי עָבְרוֹ לְפָנֵינוּ:
segments.en: And behold — throughout all of Tuesday and Wednesday we were occupied with selling books, going and coming between Uskudar and Galata. And my entire essential intention was to find buyers for the books of Rabbainu zichrono livracha. And I did not merit to find buyers for Rabbainu's books until Wednesday morning — when I sold six large volumes of Likutay Moharan. And on the night belonging to Wednesday — we slept overnight at the yeshivah.
